name: Cold River Furniture
old_description: in 2019 and 2020 at the annual League of NH Craftsmen’s Fair, the oldest and largest craft show in the country.
about:
Cold River Furniture operates from South Acworth, New Hampshire, where master furniture maker Peter Maynard established his workshop in 1975 after completing an apprenticeship at the George Whitmore Furniture Company in Middletown, Connecticut. Maynard, who began his training at age 18 under second- and third-generation Connecticut River Valley craftsmen, moved to the upper Connecticut River Valley to start his own company. His wife, Marcie, has been integral to the business since its inception, handling communications and project coordination.

The studio produces original, handcrafted fine furniture using select North American hardwoods. Maynard combines antique water-powered machinery — including a 19th-century tenoning machine — with modern tools and extensive handwork. Joinery relies on full mortise-and-tenon and hand-cut dovetails, supplemented by Chinese and Japanese woodworking techniques. Each piece undergoes multiple sanding rounds, three coats of stain, and six coats of thin tung oil varnish. The workshop also handles log procurement, sawing flitch-matched lumber, and careful drying. Output is limited to signed, one-of-a-kind pieces shipped across North America.

Clients include private collectors, interior designers, and institutions such as the Metropolitan Museum of Art, which has commissioned work. The business serves the high-end residential and collector markets.

Maynard emphasizes a connection to the New England landscape and a commitment to integrity in craft. He describes the work as a deliberate alternative to mass production, where the mark of the human hand is central. The company's philosophy centers on creating heirloom pieces that gain value over time, rooted in a lifestyle of simplicity and focus.

name: ColdSnap
old_description: From super creamy ice cream, to frozen lattes and protein shakes, ColdSnap offers delicious options for everyone.
about:
Based in Billerica, Massachusetts, ColdSnap designs and sells a commercial frozen treat machine and a line of shelf‑stable pods that produce frozen desserts and beverages on demand.

The ColdSnap machine accepts pre‑filled pods containing a liquid base that is churned and frozen in roughly two to three minutes, delivering ice cream, frozen lattes, protein shakes, smoothies, or non‑dairy treats without the need for refrigeration or cleaning. The pods remain shelf‑stable for up to nine months, simplifying inventory compared with conventional frozen products. ColdSnap also provides diagnostics and repair services for its equipment.

The system targets businesses that face space, plumbing, or staffing constraints, including hospitality and wellness venues, offices, senior‑living communities, sports and entertainment facilities, car dealerships, colleges and universities, and golf and sports clubs. It is also positioned for micro‑markets and self‑service retail environments.

ColdSnap emphasizes that its pods eliminate cold‑storage requirements and food‑contact surfaces, reducing hassle and sanitation concerns. The company states its products are built to work better and last longer, solving real problems with clean design and honest materials.

name: Cole's Sheet Metal Welding
old_description: Professional welding, fabrication, and metal sales including carbon steel, stainless steel, galvanized steel, and aluminum. Serving Effingham, SC and the surrounding Pee Dee region.
about:
Cole's Sheet Metal and Welding operates from Effingham, South Carolina, serving the surrounding Pee Dee region from its location at 5108 S Irby St. Founded as a local welding and fabrication shop, the company provides professional welding, fabrication, and metal sales to both residential and commercial customers.

The shop offers MIG, TIG, and stick welding for all metal joining needs, alongside custom metal fabrication tailored to client specifications. Sheet metal services include precision cutting, bending, and forming. The company also stocks a range of metals for immediate sale, including carbon steel, stainless steel, galvanized steel, and aluminum, providing a single source for material and fabrication.

Its customer base spans homeowners and businesses across the Pee Dee area, with projects ranging from structural components to decorative metalwork. The company showcases its work on a Facebook gallery and invites quote requests through its website.

The business emphasizes reliable workmanship under the tagline 'Built Strong. Welded Right,' reflecting a focus on durability and proper technique.

name: Collinsville T-shirt Factory
old_description: After 40 years of hands-on screen printing experience, we’re experts at
about:
Collinsville T-shirt Factory operates from the historic Axe Factory building in Collinsville, Connecticut. The business began 40 years ago when Linda, the current owner, launched Collinsville Screen Printing with a handful of silk-screen projects for friends. What started as a creative outlet grew into a local resource for custom apparel decoration.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery for custom apparel. Its screen-printing presses handle one-, two-, and three-color jobs on cotton and cotton-blend fabrics, while embroidery adds a classic, durable finish for logos and artwork. Production takes place in the historic Axe Factory building, though the company does not disclose facility size or employee count.

Clients range from individuals and schools to businesses and organizations of all kinds. The factory regularly supplies shirts for team uniforms, corporate branding, promotional events, and non-profit fundraisers, drawing on catalogs from suppliers such as 4brandedwearables.com, CompanyCasuals.com, and SportswearCollection.com.

Linda emphasizes the honesty of the work, gratitude for the craft, and the relationships built over four decades. The company highlights its 40-plus years of experience, local accessibility, and a commitment to bringing each event or promotion to life with consistent quality.

name: Colonial Furniture
old_description: family owned, financially secure, manufacturer of quality Solid Cherry
about:
Colonial Furniture operates from Freeburg, Pennsylvania, as a family-owned manufacturer of solid cherry furniture. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or the names of its founders. It began as a maker of quality solid cherry furniture, with a focus on compatibility with Pennsylvania House Furniture lines.

The company produces a range of solid cherry furniture for the bedroom, dining room, and living room. Offerings include beds, dressers, nightstands, sideboards, dining tables, chairs, bookcases, TV cabinets, and specialty items such as hooked bed rails and wood bed slats. Colonial Furniture maintains a factory outlet store at its Freeburg facility, where customers can view and purchase pieces by appointment.

Colonial Furniture serves residential customers seeking solid cherry furniture, including those looking for pieces that match Pennsylvania House collections. The factory outlet model allows direct sales to consumers, while the company’s emphasis on solid wood construction appeals to buyers avoiding veneer or composite alternatives.

The business highlights its family-owned structure and financial stability as foundations for consistent quality. By manufacturing exclusively in solid cherry, the company positions itself as a source for durable, heirloom-grade furniture rather than mass-market imitations.

about:
Colorado Custom Metalwork Inc. operates from Denver, Colorado. The family-owned business has accumulated decades of experience in custom metal fabrication, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. The company was established to bring craftsmanship and creativity together for bespoke metalwork solutions.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication for residential and commercial spaces, producing gates, railings, architectural elements, floating and curved staircases, spiral staircases, and baby or dog gates. All products receive a powder-coated finish for durability and weather resistance. The team handles design, fabrication, and finishing in-house, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Clients range from homeowners seeking custom railings or staircases to commercial projects needing architectural metalwork. A testimonial from a Wheat Ridge resident highlights residential work, while the company's portfolio includes both residential and commercial installations.

The company emphasizes its family-owned, locally crafted approach, free consultations and estimates, fast turnaround, and an experienced team as key differentiators. It positions itself on delivering functional, visually stunning pieces built to last.

name: Colorado Energy Experts
old_description: Solar is only part of the equation. We design coordinated solar and storage systems that protect your home, manage rising energy costs, and support future expansion.
about:
Colorado Energy Experts operates from Denver, Colorado, serving homeowners across the Front Range. The company focuses on coordinated solar and storage systems designed to protect homes, manage rising energy costs, and support future expansion. Its founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides whole-home energy upgrades that integrate solar panels, battery storage, inverters, high-efficiency heat pumps, windows, and insulation. Rather than selling individual products, it uses an Energy Planning Engine to model solar sizing, storage strategy, and long-term savings, then sequences upgrades so each improvement works with the others. The process begins with a discovery conversation to assess current usage, future electric demand, backup goals, and home efficiency before any equipment is recommended.

Customers are primarily Colorado homeowners facing unpredictable electric bills, aging HVAC systems, or uneven temperatures. The company addresses concerns such as backup power sizing, cost control, and avoiding oversized solutions. Examples include homeowners seeking to reduce grid reliance, replace a furnace or air conditioner, or fix drafty rooms.

Colorado Energy Experts distinguishes itself by starting with a planning conversation instead of a product pitch, emphasizing clarity over sales pressure. It aims to help homeowners understand tradeoffs, assumptions, and the right sequence of upgrades before moving to quotes or installation.

name: Colorado Food Showroom
old_description: Since 1997 Colorado Food Showroom has been dedicated to promoting and marketing specialty food products.
about:
Colorado Food Showroom operates from Denver, Colorado, where it was founded in 1997 by Jake Hunter, who serves as owner and operator. The company began with a focus on promoting and marketing specialty food products sourced from Colorado and the surrounding region.

The business functions as a full-line wholesaler, curating and warehousing a broad assortment of Colorado Proud foods and beverages across categories including snacks, sweets, beverages, pantry staples, health and beauty items, and automotive products. It carries brands such as Kettle Head Popcorn, Chocolove, Sweetwood Smokehouse, Hammond's Candies, and Eldorado Water, among dozens of others. In spring 2020, the company partnered with Hyperion Wholesale to extend direct distribution to hundreds of brick-and-mortar locations along the Front Range.

Its primary customers are retailers and business owners seeking to stock specialty foods or enhance employee retention programs. The company serves grocery stores, convenience shops, and corporate buyers looking for local and national specialty products, offering a B2B e-commerce platform with wholesale pricing.

Colorado Food Showroom differentiates itself by consolidating sourcing and warehousing so clients avoid tracking down products individually, and it backs orders with a buy-back guarantee against defects. The team, including inventory lead Sandy Frank and product scout Frankie Serrano, emphasizes "better for you" snacks with fewer preservatives and a commitment to Colorado-made brands.

name: Colorado Power Electronics, Inc
old_description: Colorado Power Electronics (CPE) is a manufacturer of high voltage equipment.
about:
Colorado Power Electronics (CPE) was incorporated in 1996 in Fort Collins, Colorado. The company was founded by Geoff Drummond, who remains the owner. Drummond brought experience from designing high-volume power supplies for the plasma thin-film industry, and he established CPE to provide high-voltage equipment to the traveling-wave tube (TWT) manufacturing sector for military and space applications.

CPE manufactures high-voltage power supplies with low stored energy, solid-state pulsers, TWT solid-state modulators, and ion thrusters including ion engines and Hall thrusters. The firm also offers custom analog and mixed-signal design solutions. In-house capabilities cover PCB design and layout, PCB assembly, system assembly, test and calibration verification, and a fully equipped R&D laboratory. The company emphasizes customized solutions tailored to specific application requirements.

CPE’s products are used by manufacturers of military and space TWTA test stations and ion implanters. The company also serves the thin-film industry, where its high-power DC and pulser products are described as the market leader for both U.S. and European sales. Additional industrial applications round out the customer base.

CPE differentiates itself through its focus on customized high-voltage solutions, supported by an in-house R&D and service laboratory. The founder holds several patents for power converters and plasma thin-film processes. The company also provides a service center, training programs, technical application notes, and product manuals to support customers throughout the product lifecycle.
